query: Hi there, I just bought that new scratch-resistant tempered glass screen protector for my phone last week, but right now I can't get any mobile data to work at all while I'm traveling abroad. I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my network preference is acting all weird, data mode is off, and roaming is disabled too, can you help me figure out how to fix this?
